originalTitle: Nothing confirms layoffs, but calls market exit rumors ‘fake news’
summary: In response to a report that Nothing is planning to "exit 12 markets as global shipments decline," Nothing cofounder Akis Evangelidis said the company is "reorganizing" and laying off some of its staff, but that "the reported numbers are way overblown." content: In response to a report that Nothing is planning to “exit 12 markets as global shipments decline,” Nothing cofounder Akis Evangelidis said the company is “reorganizing” and laying off some of its staff, but that “the reported numbers are way overblown.” Evangelidis disputed a claim about underwhelming sales for Nothing’s Phone 4B, saying it “sold 29,537 units on Day 1 only, breaking records in its price segment.” He also said Nothing isn’t shutting down in any markets, and is instead “consolidating” its operations into regional hubs as well as introducing an “AI-native” business unit. The update comes as rising component prices squeeze the midrange phone segment where Nothing typically operates, with no sign of relief anytime soon. Last month, Evangelidis announced that Nothing’s budget CMF brand won’t release a new phone this year due to ongoing component shortages. Nothing CEO Carl Pei also said last month that memory costs for the Phone 4A have doubled since its launch earlier this year, and claimed that RAM can now account for half the cost of a new phone. > FAKE NEWS... We are not shutting down any markets. Inaccurate reports are being circulated; Phone (4b) sold 29,537 units on Day 1 only, breaking records in its price segment. > What we are doing is reorganising our teams to prepare for our next phase of growth. We are introducing dedicated business units - including an AI-native business unit - and consolidating individual countries into regional hubs to operate much more efficiently. > These changes have impacted certain positions, and while we are unable to share specific details due to regulatory compliance and ongoing local consultation processes, the reported numbers are way overblown, and we call on the media to uphold factual reporting and journalistic integrity. > Decisions that impact people’s livelihoods are never taken lightly, and we know how difficult this transition is for our team members who are affected. We are deeply grateful for their contributions and are fully committed to supporting them through this process. > While these are hard decisions, it is a necessary step to position us to shape the next era of personal computing.
chineseTitle: 没有任何消息证实裁员，但称市场退出传闻为“假新闻”
chineseSummary: 针对《Nothing》计划“因全球出货量下降而退出 12 个市场”的报道，Nothing 联合创始人 Akis Evangelidis 表示，该公司正在“重组”并解雇部分员工，但“报道的数字被夸大了”。 Evangelidis 反驳了有关 Nothing's Phone 4B 销量不佳的说法，称它“卖出了 […]
chineseContent: 针对《Nothing》计划“因全球出货量下降而退出 12 个市场”的报道，Nothing 联合创始人 Akis Evangelidis 表示，该公司正在“重组”并解雇部分员工，但“报道的数字被夸大了”。 Evangelidis 反驳了有关 Nothing’s Phone 4B 销量惨淡的说法，称其“仅第一天就售出 29,537 部，打破了同价位段的记录。”他还表示，Nothing 并没有关闭任何市场，而是将其业务“整合”到区域中心，并引入“人工智能原生”业务部门。这一更新发布之际，零部件价格上涨挤压了通常没有任何功能的中端手机市场，而且短期内没有缓解的迹象。上个月，Evangelidis 宣布，由于持续的零部件短缺，Nothing 的预算型 CMF 品牌今年不会发布新手机。 Nothing首席执行官Carl Pei上个月还表示，自今年早些时候推出以来，Phone 4A的内存成本已经翻了一番，并声称RAM现在可以占新手机成本的一半。 > 假新闻...我们不会关闭任何市场。不准确的报告正在流传； Phone (4b) 仅在第一天就售出了 29,537 部，打破了同价位段的记录。 > 我们正在做的是重组我们的团队，为下一阶段的增长做好准备。我们正在引入专门的业务部门（包括人工智能原生业务部门），并将各个国家/地区整合为区域中心，以提高运营效率。 > 这些变化影响了某些立场，虽然由于监管合规性和正在进行的当地咨询流程，我们无法分享具体细节，但报告的数字被夸大了，我们呼吁媒体在报道中坚持事实报道和新闻报道。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
